overview.text: 期 means a period, date, or time limit. It combines 月, a time-related meaning element, with 其 as a sound element; early forms leave the original motivation unsettled.

components.text: 月 contributes a time-related meaning in one reported form; the original motivation is unsettled.
其 supplies the sound element; the historical readings support a sound relationship, though they do not prove its role by themselves.
